text_block_list.text: Just as Ines Fuujin finished all of her training for today—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Good work~! 
It somehow felt like it was over in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I have my delivery gig after this,
so how about I do some solo training while working?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I usually ride a bicycle,
but this time I'll make the rounds on my own two feet!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Working a part-time job, breaking a sweat,
and getting some training in too—
delivery really is the best job ever!

Ines Fujin is full of motivation, but if she goes
running around making deliveries right now,
she's bound to overwork herself...
choice_data_list: Go out there and do your best!
That'll lead to overwork, so let's take the bicycle instead.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you-no!
Well then, off I go-no~!
After that, Ines Fujin gave her absolute all to the deliveries, getting quite a workout in the process.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I see. If fatigue builds up, it'll end up getting in the way of regular training instead.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I understand! If you say so, I'll use a bicycle!

Ines Fujin obediently listened to my advice,
and we were able to prevent her from overworking.
